actions.description: Draft action for posting a governed comment to an Octane defect. The current system supports dry-run preview and explicit apply through the duplicate-comment workflow, but this ontology action is not approved for autonomous execution.

Blocked action documenting that destructive Octane defect deletion is outside autonomous agent capability. Keep this explicit so delete intents are routed to policy explanation instead of ad-hoc tool use.
Disabled draft action for future governed updates to selected Octane defect triage fields. It records field candidates and guardrails before any executor is implemented.

descriptions.en-US: An actor-authorized artifact that can support an Agent claim.
descriptions.zh-CN: 由 Agent 授权读取并可用于支持 Claim 的附件。

descriptions.zh-CN: 192条客户功能到DTSV团队的映射关系。用于缺陷自动分派和团队责任界定。

descriptions.en-US: A delivery or testing team in the organization.
descriptions.zh-CN: 组织中的交付或测试团队。

descriptions.en-US: A person who executes a test run.
descriptions.zh-CN: 执行测试运行的人员。

descriptions.en-US: An ECU or module assigned to a defect or feature.
descriptions.zh-CN: 分配缺陷或功能的 ECU/模块。

descriptions.en-US: A software integration level.
descriptions.zh-CN: 软件集成级别。

descriptions.en-US: A vehicle software OS generation.
descriptions.zh-CN: 车辆软件 OS 代际。

descriptions.en-US: A product technology platform.
descriptions.zh-CN: 产品技术平台。

descriptions.en-US: A product or delivery project.
descriptions.zh-CN: 产品或交付项目。

descriptions.en-US: A product unit.
descriptions.zh-CN: 产品单元。

descriptions.en-US: A product delivery service pack.
descriptions.zh-CN: 产品交付 Service Pack。

descriptions.en-US: IuK test rack for software integration testing with modular design.
descriptions.zh-CN: IuK测试台架，用于软件集成测试。分为开发系统、集群系统等模块化设计。

descriptions.en-US: A uniquely identified quality defect in Octane.
descriptions.zh-CN: Octane 中唯一标识的质量缺陷。

descriptions.zh-CN: 缺陷单状态或字段变更的历史记录，用于判定缺陷是否解决。

descriptions.zh-CN: 缺陷的归一化结果判定，包括正向解决和直接拒绝。

descriptions.en-US: A gate that evaluates product quality under approved rules.
descriptions.zh-CN: 按照已批准规则评估产品质量的门禁。

descriptions.en-US: A node in the AIDA requirement hierarchy.
descriptions.zh-CN: AIDA 需求层级中的节点。

descriptions.en-US: An epic-level requirement work item.
descriptions.zh-CN: Epic 级需求工作项。

descriptions.en-US: A feature-level requirement work item.
descriptions.zh-CN: Feature 级需求工作项。

descriptions.en-US: A story-level requirement work item.
descriptions.zh-CN: Story 级需求工作项。

descriptions.en-US: A reusable definition of a test intent.
descriptions.zh-CN: 定义可重复执行的测试意图。

descriptions.en-US: Release test event corresponding to Octane Feature, with capacity planning.
descriptions.zh-CN: Release测试事件，对应Octane中的Feature。包含Release、SET、车型、国家容量规划等信息。

descriptions.en-US: One traceable execution of a test case.
descriptions.zh-CN: 测试用例的一次可追溯执行。

descriptions.zh-CN: 测试执行与缺陷、Feature、Story之间的追溯关系。

descriptions.en-US: A vehicle model series.
descriptions.zh-CN: 车辆车型系列。

descriptions.en-US: DTSV test vehicle, booked via FIPS system.
descriptions.zh-CN: DTSV测试车辆，通过FIPS系统预约。分为工作日和周末测试驾驶。

metrics.description: Elapsed calendar days under an approved clock-stop rule.
metrics.grain: one age value per defect at snapshot

metrics.description: Distinct defect primary keys in the authorized snapshot and selected scope.
Distinct defects grouped or filtered by their creation event time.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct defect_id creation event

metrics.description: Distinct eligible defects whose approved age exceeds an approved threshold.
metrics.grain: one current snapshot state per eligible defect

metrics.description: Distinct defects not in the approved terminal status set at the snapshot time.
metrics.grain: one current snapshot state per defect

metrics.description: Distinct defects classified by an approved rejection outcome rule.
metrics.grain: one approved rejection outcome per defect

metrics.description: Approved rejected defects divided by the approved defect cohort denominator.
Defects with an approved duplicate linkage divided by an approved defect cohort.
Approved resolved defects divided by the approved defect cohort denominator.
Distinct defects entering an approved resolved outcome during the resolution-time window.
metrics.grain: one approved resolution event per defect

metrics.description: 在Showstopper阶段(通常I-480~I-490)，上线前必须修复的缺陷数。标记为'Showstopper_Candidat'的潜在Showstopper
metrics.measure: count_distinct(defect_id WHERE reporting_class LIKE '%Showstopper%' OR user_tags LIKE '%Showstopper%')

metrics.description: 在Top Issue阶段(通常I-420~I-470)，阻止功能达到预期Reifegrad的缺陷数。这类缺陷需要在Octane的'Assign'字段标记为'Preventing Maturity Grade ConDrive'
metrics.measure: count_distinct(defect_id WHERE reporting_class LIKE '%Top Issue%' OR user_tags LIKE '%TopIssue%')

metrics.description: 已测试的车型变体数 / I-Step交付支持的总车型变体数。目标100%
100%覆盖硬件变体(High, Mid, Base, Premium)。目标100%
DDP = R1 / (R1 + R2) * 100%。R1=上线前发现的缺陷数，R2=上线后发现的缺陷数。目标≥99%
metrics.grain: defects detected before vs after customer release
metrics.measure: count_distinct(defect_id WHERE phase NOT IN ('06-Concluded','09-Concluded without action') AND creation_time < release_date) / count_distinct(defect_id) * 100

metrics.description: CWA(Child Without Action)率。子缺陷被直接拒绝的比例。目标≤10%
metrics.measure: count_distinct(defect_id WHERE parent_child_type='child' AND phase='09-Concluded without action') / count_distinct(defect_id WHERE parent_child_type='child') * 100

metrics.description: 功能(AIDA)的需求或验收标准覆盖率。目标100%。由流程保证
每个DTSV周期中，至少执行过一次测试的RG5已签收功能数 / RG5功能总数。目标100%
metrics.grain: RG5 signed-off features with at least one test case executed
metrics.measure: count_distinct(test_id WHERE rg_level='RG5' AND run_count > 0) / count_distinct(test_id WHERE rg_level='RG5') * 100

metrics.description: Defect count divided by an explicitly approved size or exposure denominator.
Distinct defects attributed to the canonical problem-finder team field.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct defect_id and problem-finder team

metrics.description: An approved discovery outcome divided by an approved execution or effort denominator.
Distinct manual runs attributed to a tester or team.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct mr_id and authorized team attribution

metrics.description: Failed runs divided by the approved eligible-run denominator.
Distinct manual runs with the canonical Failed status.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct failed mr_id

metrics.description: Passed runs divided by the approved eligible-run denominator.
Distinct manual runs with the canonical Passed status.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct passed mr_id

metrics.description: Requirements with approved validating test cases divided by the approved requirement population.
Distinct manual run IDs completed in the selected scope.
Distinct test case IDs in the selected scope.
Eligible test runs with approved requirement links divided by eligible runs.
